events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, 'An Aquarian Exposition: 3 Days of Peace & Music', kicked off on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Kick-off
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, music, and a lineup that defined a generation. We're still talking about it now.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shape music and culture worldwide. Still rocking the airwaves.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, still rocking after all these years. A true icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis to his solo work, the man's still got it. Definitely maybe a legend.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007, from 'Dr. No' in '62 to today. What's your go-to Bond theme to get you in the mood?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incredible John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to resonate globally. Imagine that.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. No silly walks today, please.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us far too soon. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. The show must go on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution. Pure genius.
